crossRefs.note: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served…
Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.
Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.

translations.web: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.
translations.bsb: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
translations.kjv: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
translations.asv: I will observe thy statutes: Oh forsake me not utterly.
